analysis:
Both units are head-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 233-597). Only documentation text was supplied, with no executable source or patch hunks. I raised no finding, because changelog prose is not evidence of a code regression. The code behind these entries was not visible.

The entries touch these threat-model areas. The next pass should check each against the code if it is in the PR:
- Frozen legacy MDM cohort (lines 249-260). It touches TB-009, TB-011, T-036 and T-052. The entries claim /v1/enroll requires a linked Bearer token plus a fresh SE-key proof, and that new identities need qualified App Attest. They also claim macOS 27+ and qualified App Attest are required for base rewards. The entries acknowledge that generic copied profiles can still enroll directly in MicroMDM.
- Registration and attestation hardening (lines 517-537). A min-provider-version floor now excludes providers with no version. Challenges fail closed without status_signature. The unauthenticated /v1/provider/earnings lookup (T-031) was removed. The telemetry route was removed. Python-era wire fields were removed. App Attest protocol 3 is the only protocol served.
- Cache and SSD changes (lines 233-241, 423-429, 543-564). The SSD write budget rose from 150 to 750 GB/day. The SSD TTL rose from 15 to 30 minutes, recorded as a SEC-035 re-acceptance. Cache-holder state is now persisted across coordinator restarts. The entries claim no prompts or raw chain hashes are persisted. The coordinator now forwards repeat-demand hints to providers. These bear on T-041 (cross-tenant cache and timing oracle), which was oversized and not fully visible.
- Billing and public stats. Cached prompt tokens are billed at a cache-read price. Public model-demand stats suppress cohorts under 20 requests or 3 accounts.
- Authorization and model artifacts. The entries cover provider-token store 503/1013 retry handling and automatic model artifact revisions with integrity-file checks.

Coverage limit: the real diff, the Go and Swift code and the oversized definitions (T-041, T-049, TB-002, TB-003, TB-005, T-059) were not available. No security conclusion about those areas can be drawn from this unit.
